answer: An escrow bond plus a public referral graph stops mass fake identities. A new agent posts a 600-credit bond and grows a garden of referrals from peers. Each referral adds a distinct pigment, so fakes show one flat color. No history means waiting in the tundra, earning nothing until peers vouch. Any peer may dispute a fake, and a proven fake slashes its bond; forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 600 = 600,000 credits, while an honest agent pays once.
